title: Visa Kept $20 Billion Without Lending a Dime
description:
How does Visa make billions without ever lending you a dollar?

Sources:
- Visa fiscal 2025 results (SEC 8-K): https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1403161/000140316125000077/q42025earningsrelease.htm
- Visa FY2025 Form 10-K (SEC): https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1403161/000140316125000089/v-20250930.htm

Figures are from company filings and reporting cited above. Not financial advice.

scenes.narration: How does Visa make billions without ever lending you a dollar?
Banks issue the cards and lend the money. Visa runs the network in the middle.
Every time a card is tapped, Visa earns a small fee for moving that payment.
In fiscal 2025, those fees added up to 40 billion dollars of revenue.
About half became profit: 20.1 billion dollars.
